publicUi.intro: A literary bar in Bishkek: books, signature drinks and conversations you do not want to end.
publicUi.conceptTitle: An evening with a good story
publicUi.conceptText: Meet over dinner, open a favourite book or linger over conversation. Stock photos convey the project's mood and do not depict a real venue.
publicUi.emptyEvents: New gatherings will be announced soon
publicUi.emptyReviews: There are no published reviews yet
publicUi.aboutTitle: A meeting place between the lines
publicUi.aboutText: Literator is a demonstration project for a literary bar and reading club in Bishkek, bringing together books, a small kitchen and evening gatherings.
publicUi.stockNote: Stock images illustrate the atmosphere and dishes.
publicUi.demoNote: Menu items, events and reviews are currently examples. Prices and announcements are not a public offer.
publicUi.addressNote: The address is fictional — this is a demonstration website.
publicUi.eventBookingNote: A table reservation is not an event registration.

publicUi.footerText: Books, food and conversation in one place.

cookies.title: Cookies and privacy settings
cookies.description: We save your age confirmation and preferences in your browser. Essential cookies are used for administrator sign-in. The external OpenStreetMap map loads only with your consent: the service receives your IP address and browser information. We currently use no analytics or advertising cookies.
cookies.storage: Your choice is saved on this device. You can change it using “Cookie settings” at the bottom of the site.

bot.welcome: Welcome to Literator — a meeting place between the lines. Use the buttons for our menu, events and reservations.
bot.help: A table booking is a request: an administrator confirms availability. Event RSVPs reserve seats immediately. Commands: /menu /tables /book /events /contacts /language.
bot.notAdmin: This command is only available to a linked administrator. Connect in the web admin panel → Telegram.
bot.linked: Telegram is connected to your admin account. Commands: /today, /pending, /booking <id>, /confirm <id>, /decline <id>, /admin.
bot.linkExpired: This connection link expired or has already been used. Generate a new one in the web admin panel → Telegram.
bot.already: Current status: {booking_status}. No repeat action is needed.
bot.conflict: Current status: {booking_status}. This booking has already been handled. Refresh to see the decision and actor.
bot.past: A past booking cannot be confirmed. Check the date in the admin panel.
bot.syntax: Provide the full booking ID: /booking <id>. Copy it from /pending or /today.
bot.noEvents: New events will be announced soon.
